fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with weathered hands returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 50s, with a long braid settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a long braid.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 30s paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
A woman, maybe 40s traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Cecília and Otto lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Hatchet at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Bark armor at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
📓 Journal: the man in his 50s, with weathered hands taught the person in their 30s Herbal Medicine.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A woman, maybe 40s watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Someone asks the man in his 40s, with a broad frame, the midwife a shop-talk question about midwife work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame).

👀 "veterinarian, huh?" the man in his 40s, with ink-stained fingers, the veterinarian nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no veterinarian would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 40s, with ink-stained fingers).
🔥 Rafael says it at the fire, not quite looking at Javier: “Your past story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.
Snow by morning. (0°C — Cold) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
Javier Seo reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 20s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
A person, maybe 20s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 30s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 20s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 50s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 50s, with a long braid — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"August," they say, touching their chest. "I'm August." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (August).
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 60s speaks 🇮🇹 Italian. You share no language at all.
They point at themself and say it slowly, twice. It sounds like a name: Giulia.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Giulia).
Giulia speaks only 🇮🇹 Italian. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
"Rafael," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Rafael." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Rafael).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
A person, maybe 50s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 August — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 30s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 50s, with weathered hands speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Raj," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Raj." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Raj).
"Guadalupe," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Guadalupe." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Guadalupe).

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
A hollow log big enough to crawl into. You don't crawl in. You note where it is, in case the weather ever makes the offer again.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
Sign — a long gray snake coiled on a sunlit log passed here recently. Fresh prints. Close, maybe.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s telling A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You break ground behind the hall — bed 3 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 4 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip returns with water: +4 clean.
August is sweeping the hall. Someone has to.
📨 Word came: David Kim wants to join Haven. "I can work. That's all I'm selling." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: David Kim applied remotely.
🗣️ Rafael to a man, maybe 50s, with a long braid, by the fire: "Stone. We need 58 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1185 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
August spends the afternoon with the thorny bush with dark berries — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Blackberry — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Blackberry. Thorny canes, dark berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 The thorny bush with dark berries — THAT's what August was describing. Blackberry. It clicks like a key turning.
A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame was watching. Now they know Blackberry too.
Guadalupe is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 73/100)
August traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
🤢 Guadalupe's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
🤢 Javier's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
Cecília and August lingered over the fire together.
Giulia and Cecília lingered over the fire together.
Raj and Giulia lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Rafael sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."

🛟 August stands up by the fire. "People are going down and the tents are filling — we do something or we don't, but we decide. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can nurse them through it, or go lean and ride it out, or send the strong out hunting while the sick rest. Say which."
"Or we rally," August adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Journal: August proposed relief (sickness), day 3.
— DAY 4 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown berries went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Blackberry — named and noted.
Javier Seo reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
August will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 August — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Guadalupe — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Otto," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Otto." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Otto).
"Ivy," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ivy." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ivy).
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
You catch fragments by the fire — Raj telling A man, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip about A person, maybe 50s. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
Something big drank here recently — the mud is churned to soup on the far bank. You drink from the near side, upstream of whatever it was.
Sign — a broad flat-tailed beaver, working the bank passed here recently. Fresh prints. Close, maybe.
✅ You saw the creek. Raj nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 10 people, 4 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Slow water. The cattails stand thick.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.

Raj leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about the humming in the grass. Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — the humming in the grass: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
